profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own site. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and trades under the ticker SPCX. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001181412. It also appears under the names SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP and SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

No AI products are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded. Its recorded law exposure is in Texas, with a count of 126.
